newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates stocks rise on bank gains.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates stocks rise on bank gains.

text.p: Shares on the United Arab Emirates informal stock exchange ended the week to Thursday higher on the back of gains by bank shares, traders said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index rose 15.67 points to 2,619.81 from 2,604.14.
Of the 27 shares traded on the market, 16 rose and the rest remained unchanged, traders said.
Emirates Bank International gained one dirham to 26 dirhams, while the NBAD and the National Bank of Dubai rose five dirhams each to 555 and 700 dirhams respectively, traders said.
Commercial Bank of Dubai shares rose two dirhams to 70 dirhams, some traders said.
Market leader Etisalat rose to 1,005 dirhams from 1,000, while Abu Dhabi National Hotels Co continued its rise from last week, gaining five dirhams to 125 dirhams.
Some traders quoted Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co up at 1,130 dirhams from 1,125.
Traders said Emaar Properties was traded four dirhams higher at 20, continuing last week's gain which came after the company announced a new housing project.
Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding rose one dirham to 35 dirhams. ($1=3.67 dirhams)
